verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an MCP registry, hosting, gateway and chat platform like Glama, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents selecting or acting on many servers, tools, chats or other items in one operation. Per-tool enable/disable, directory synchronization and schedule/webhook automation are adjacent features or belong to other stories, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
